title: Ordinary finite pullback respects the native single-degree unit comparison
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, S and T schemes, and g:T -> S. The specified ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A g, followed by the native singleFunctorObjUnitIso on T, equals ordinaryFinitePullback A g applied to the native singleFunctorObjUnitIso on S, followed by leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso for g. The statement uses the actual finite constant-object inverse-image comparison and actual monoidal unit comparison, without Noetherian, torsion or compactification assumptions.

proof.text: Postcompose ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback with constantUnit_hom on T in reverse. Apply the proved constantUnit_pullback equation. Apply congruence with constantUnit_hom on S to its inverse-image factor. Transitivity gives the displayed equation; leftDerivedUpperStarDerivedTensorUnitIso is the native leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso by its definition.

theorem ordinaryFiniteSingleUnitPullback_hom (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S) :
    (Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A g).hom ≫
        (Etale.singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).hom =
      (Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback A g).map
        (Etale.singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S).hom ≫
        (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).hom
